Read assignment deadlines from a course site's schedule.csv

Source: R/github.R
read_due_dates.Rd

Builds an assign/due lookup for check_late() from the course website repo's schedule.csv, which is the single source of truth for deadlines – move a date there and the late check follows.

read_due_dates(path, time = "23:59:59", tz = Sys.timezone(), stub_map = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the course site's schedule.csv, e.g. here::here("..", "2026-Fall", "schedule.csv").

time

Time of day assignments are due, as "HH:MM:SS". Defaults to "23:59:59" (the 11:59pm deadline in the syllabus late policy).

tz

Time zone for the deadlines. Defaults to the system time zone.

stub_map

Optional named character vector mapping project stubs that don't match their assign name after hyphen conversion.

Value

A tibble with assign and due (POSIXct) columns.

Details

Handles the three deliverable families in that file's schema: homework (n_assign/due_assign, named hw1, hw2, ...), mini projects (n_mini/due_mini, named mini1, ...), and project deliverables (stub_project/due_project). Column groups that are absent are skipped.

Project stubs on the site are hyphenated (final-analysis) while the assign names in pars.R use underscores (final_analysis), so hyphens are converted automatically. Use stub_map for anything that needs more than that, e.g. c(presentation = "final_presentation").

Instructor-run work (quizzes, exams, interviews, participation) has no repo submission and so gets no deadline; those simply never appear here.
